plan_review_findings.title: The EKS CNI is not configured to enforce NetworkPolicies
plan_review_findings.description: Adding and applying a NetworkPolicy does not restrict traffic on this cluster unless VPC CNI network-policy support is enabled. The task explicitly forbids the necessary Tofu edit, so its security outcome would be inert.
plan_review_findings.evidence: deploy/eks/tofu/eks.tf:52-59 configures the vpc-cni add-on only with before_compute=true. `rg -n 'configuration_values|enableNetworkPolicy|ENABLE_NETWORK_POLICY|NetworkPolicy' .` found no enforcement configuration. AWS documents that EKS VPC CNI policy enforcement is disabled by default and requires `enableNetworkPolicy: "true"` ([Amazon EKS user guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-network-policy-configure.html)).
plan_review_findings.recommendation: Add deploy/eks/tofu/eks.tf to task 5 and replace ac7 so it permits only the VPC CNI enforcement setting while still prohibiting identifier, bucket, and state-key changes.

suggested_change.proposed: Plan constraint 4 holds: no Tofu identifier, state bucket or state key changes. Configure the existing vpc-cni add-on in deploy/eks/tofu/eks.tf with `enableNetworkPolicy: "true"` so Kubernetes NetworkPolicy resources are enforced; this add-on configuration is the only allowed deploy/eks/tofu edit, and Tofu validation must pass.

plan_review_findings.title: Patch-regeneration provenance cannot be graded from the final diff
plan_review_findings.description: A hand-edited patch and a regenerated patch can produce identical bytes. Neither the verification result nor the git diff can prove which editing process was used, and the HANDOFF exception is unavailable to the evaluator.
plan_review_findings.evidence: frontend/patches/README.md:11-24 documents the regeneration workflow, while scripts/check-frontend.sh:12-30 only stages, applies, type-checks, and lints the resulting patches. No verification step records how the patch bytes were produced. Acceptance criterion ac7 already checks the observable pre-image and clean-application properties.
plan_review_findings.recommendation: Move the regeneration instruction to task notes and remove it as a critical acceptance criterion; grade the observable patch integrity through ac7 and check-frontend.sh.
